yorum: Almost everything is perfect here! The best breakfasts!!! Truly incredible! And they're open until 1:00 PM. The view from the room is stunning, the spa is completely relaxing, the steam room is excellent, and the indoor pool is nice. The beach area is also very comfortable, especially on the beachfront. There's a promenade along the sea, and we went jogging in the mornings. The only downside is that I saw a double-headed eagle in the wet area of the rooms. And the scented rooms are overdone. Everything else is great.

Came here for my partner's birthday week and honestly can not recommend it any more. The entire hotel was incredible. ALL the staff, Margaret, Izzet, Suheyla, absolutely everyone made this the most memorable stay. I would come back here immediately, the escape lounge, the gym, the rooms were all top class. The upgraded us as it wasnt busy and put us in a beautiful room. The spa was also stunning. The pool was great. Lovely food at the restaurant as well as a beautiful breakfast spread. The location is great especially if you are willing to get some cabs. The area is nice and quiet so great to relax. 10 stars overall. Thank you everyone
The view of the water, great food and attentive staff stand out the most.

This was our first time in Bodrum and at Cape Hotel. While the resort felt luxurious overall, there were a few disappointments. Some towels were extremely worn out and should’ve been replaced. Our first room had a strong odor, but the staff acted quickly and moved us. Unfortunately, the new room wasn’t much better — it was dusty, the floors weren’t clean, and the mattresses were uncomfortable enough to cause back pain. On the bright side, the beachfront was beautiful and easily accessible. Check-in and check-out were smooth, breakfast was good, and the salon on-site was excellent — friendly staff and great service. The hotel has potential, but cleanliness and comfort need improvement.

This is a new and an amazing hotel in the most beautiful part of Bodrum. The pool and the beach club is just out of this world beautiful. The service is superb. It's 20 min to Yalikavak Marina. There aren't anything around the property so best if you have a rental car. If you like highend service from the conceige for the top places in Bodrum, you must do it yourself. The conceige is super kind but not capable to hook you up with top hard to get places. I would definitely go back as it is by far the best hotel in Bodrum.

Absolutely astounding location and aesthetic, an incredible diverse range of food including the exceptional breakfast every morning and the pool and beach area are beyond superb. But the real rockstar of this property is the absolutely unreal attention to detail and WONDEFUL staff. It’s white Lotus and all the right ways and I have Never had such an experience of feeling at home and taken care of. Truly five star and I would give it six if I could. We will be back to say the least.

Whilst I was there at the start of April which is reasonably quiet there were still things to do. I could walk to the local shops and amenities. The staff were delightful, made good suggestions for activities and nothing was too much trouble. The hammum at the in-house spa was fabulous! The food was delicious and the breakfast spread was amazing! As it was cool weather it would have been lovely to have a warm water spa/hot tub section in the outside pool area.
Staff were awesome! Kitchen worked around my food allergies with delicious results!
Great stay! Very clean scenic views from pool and beach. The breakfast is spectacular with so many options would definitely return!

Tek sorunumuz yastık oldu ama yastık menüsünde en rahat olan sleepy ortopedik yastık onu tavsiye ederim. Bu otelden çıkıp hiçbir şey yapmanıza gerek yok, bodrumda her yer zaten birbirine çok uzak. Burada yürüyüş yapabilirsiniz, spor salonu zaten var, başka bir restorana gitmeye gerek yok. Cafede oturalım derseniz en iyisi zaten burada. Tek kelimeyle mükemmel öve öve bitiremem açıkçası. Çok teşekkür ederim ederiz Cape ailesine misafirperverlikleri için. Ben buraya 100 puan veriyorum 😍
Her şey çok güzeldi, çalışanlar çok güleryüzlü ve hep yardımcıydılar. Teşekkür ederiz :)

Kusursuz bir tatil deneyimi! Tek kelime ile muhteşem bir otel. Çalışanlar güler yüzlü ve çok ilgili, kahvaltı şahane, beach çok kaliteli ve burada da hizmet muhteşem. Menüsü çeşitli ve herşey çok lezzetli, fiyatlarda çok makul. Odaların hepsi deniz manzaralı, bence çok iyi bir detay. Çok fazla otelde konakladım bu kadar memnun olduğumu hiç hatırlamıyorum. Memnun kalmamanızın imkansız olduğu bir tesis. Tek tek isim verirsem bütün ekibi yazmam gerekir bunun yerine tüm ekibe bu tatil deneyimi için çok teşekkür ederiz.

Giriş anından çıkışımıza kadar hizmet kalitesi mükemmeldi. Otel içerisindeki restaurantlarda eşsiz manzara karşısında mükemmel lezzetler tadabiliyorsunuz. Herşey ve özellikle tüm personelin güleryüzü için teşekkürler.
